war_summary: War 139 is on day 125 with no winner yet (32 victory towns required). The map remains heavily consolidated in rear areas — Colonials fully hold Acrithia, Dead Lands, Drowned Vale, Fisherman's Row and many others; Wardens fully hold Basin Sionnach, Clanshead Valley, Viper Pit, Reaching Trail and Weathered Expanse — while a handful of contested fronts drive nearly all activity. Compared to the prior snapshot (~3h ago), Callahan's Passage is now the hottest front: casualty rates have roughly doubled to ~740-790/hr per side over 2h windows (~8-9k/24h each), enlistments accelerating (~120/hr), split now 5-5 with fresh events at Scáth Passing (3 events/24h) and Solas Gorge. Clahstra continues escalating hard (~1050-1370/hr per side over 2h) with heavy fighting at Transept (9 events/24h), Bewailing Fort and East Narthex; the latest event was minutes before cutoff and the split stands 5-3 Warden. Onyx remains extremely intense (~1240-1370/hr per side over 2h, accelerating) with The Waif as a hotspot (10 events/24h), split 3 Colonial - 2 Warden - 1 NONE. Speaking Woods shows sustained heavy fighting (~550-700/hr over 2h, ~9.5k casualties/24h each side) with recent activity at The Filament, Hush and Stem; split 5-3 Warden. Endless Shore has cooled sharply from its prior surge (~150/hr per side over 2h vs ~400+ earlier) but still logged 38 events/24h around Woodbind, Brackish Point and The Overland; it remains 10-0 Colonial. Oarbreaker has reignited dramatically: 33 events/24h (Grisly Refuge alone 12), rates spiking to ~95-125/hr over 2h after near-zero, latest event at cutoff, split 6-3 Colonial. Marban Hollow cooled somewhat (~100-155/hr over 2h) but logged 10 events/24h at Sanctum and Lockheed, 4-4. Mooring County stays active (8 events/24h at Borderlane/Luch's Workshop, latest ~45min ago) though colonial casualties are cooling while warden casualties accelerate. Godcrofts, StemaLanding, Tempest Island and Tyrant Foothills show moderate ongoing fighting. Quiet rear hexes remain static.
